explanation: Choice D is correct. It's given that $h(x) = 7(3)^{x}$ and $p(x) = h(x + 2)$. Substituting $x + 2$ for $x$ in $h(x) = 7(3)^{x}$ gives $h(x + 2) = 7(3)^{x + 2}$. Using properties of exponents, this can be rewritten as $h(x + 2) = 7(3)^{x}(3)^{2}$, which is equivalent to $h(x + 2) = 7(3)^{x}(9)$. Multiplying $7$ and $9$ gives $h(x + 2) = 63(3)^{x}$. Since $p(x) = h(x + 2)$, it follows that $p(x) = 63(3)^{x}$.
